direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; main splits into independent reserved zones: rendered scene at least 70%, plus separate callout, station and job zones with no overlap; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions preserved; 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; animated flow along feasible emerald routes only; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left, wide header tabs centre, Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan can coexist while replacements await approval; action bar Back left, status centre, one primary right; skip-to-stage, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade shows living emerald flow, depth and state glow across departments

fixes.change: Enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main and shrink side evidence zone so Certificate/Receiving tracks gain depth and glow.
Raise secondary source-detail text to 16px and strengthen silver contrast inside its reserved zone.
Add persistent legend with pattern, marker and text for Held and At Risk states beside the scene.
Keep connection readiness and evidence findings visually separated with distinct headings and controls; enlarge the 3/0/3 metrics to 26px tabular.
Make verified-fact rows bidirectionally highlight the matching Certificate and Receiving tracks on focus and hover.
Trim narration to one instruction and one status sentence above the primary action.
On selecting a path, surface one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall as the single primary progression.
Add emerald route trace through feasible stations for the focused path, static after 240ms.
Enlarge path finish and cost metrics and align them on one baseline per option.
Clarify board state wording: approved plan retained, proposed replacements UNTRACKED until approval, without implying prior blocked work vanished.
Give proposed task cards more depth and state glow on the active t1 card while keeping dashed silver for untracked.
Prevent t1 label truncation in the side zone by widening its reserved zone or wrapping to two lines.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 preview strictly silver cross-hatching with x marker and WILL GO OFFLINE text, with no route drawn through it.
Strengthen cinematic depth on the invalidated accepted path while reducing glow bloom around job cards for legibility.
Enlarge the machine selector label to 16px and add a visible focus ring.
Restore a distinct connection readiness check for provider identity above the evidence task, with separate status and control.
Fill the empty findings zone with cleared-state summary at 16px instead of blank depth.
Keep constrained Split option hatched with x and OFFLINE-ADJACENT text, and remove any route through CELL-MILL-2.
Make the two feasible options glow along their real routes when focused, leaving the constrained option hatched and unrouted.
Raise side comparison body text to 16px and align finish and incremental metrics.
Shorten centre status to PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED at larger weight for faster scanning.
State coexistence plainly: 3 BLOCKED prior tasks, approved plan retained, 3 PROPOSED replacements UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL.
Differentiate blocked prior context from proposed cards in the scene so both layers read at a glance.
Fix side t1 truncation with wrapping and keep numbered task targets at least 36px.
Add state glow and a completed-flow trace across the 01-02-03 chain as each proof stage unlocks.
Raise locked-stage explanatory text to 16px and keep passphrase guidance inside its reserved zone.
Make Verify ledger the sole emerald primary and mute locked export controls until enabled.
Reduce cross-hatching dominance on fully offline departments so silver x OFFLINE labels and machine depth remain legible at 1366x768.
Extend living emerald material flow along the full feasible mills to lathes route with reduced-motion static fallback.
Enlarge department counts and legend text to at least 12px micro-labels and 16px where space allows.
Enlarge the embedded cascade visual so emerald route, silver x OFFLINE departments and live counters are legible without zooming.
Increase pitch and body copy contrast and size toward 16px for judge scanning in the required order.
Tighten hero caption repetition so the three-signals table carries the cascade explanation alone.
